title: Moui Corpus Chunk Record
description: One record in chunks.jsonl. `text` is authoritative: it is what the embedder embeds and what a citation quotes. `span` is a locator into the transcript; when `contiguous` is true the invariant transcript[span] == text holds. `ref` is a short content hash of ast_path + normalized text — deterministic and stable across reprocess, NEVER a sequential counter (a counter would reassign refs on every re-chunk and invalidate every index key and citation). Refs are UNIQUE within one document — downstream keys by ref — so a repeated identical block under the same section salts its occurrence ordinal into the hash; occurrence order follows the transcript, keeping repeats stable too.

ref.description: 'c' + first 8 hex of sha256(ast_path + '\x00' + normalized_text), with '\x00' + occurrence ordinal appended for the second and later identical blocks in a document.

ast_path.description: Heading hierarchy of the source section, joined by ' > '. Empty string for content above the first heading.

span.description: [start_char, end_char) into the transcript, in characters.

contiguous.description: True when text == transcript[span] byte-for-byte. This chunker only joins consecutive blocks, so it is ALWAYS true; the false branch is dead by design — kept so a future chunker that assembles text across a structural gap can mark itself honestly, at which point span is the enclosing range and a renderer must not claim byte-exact highlighting.

text.description: The authoritative chunk text — the exact source slice transcript[span] that the embedder embeds and a citation quotes. Never empty.
